# Netsidian 0.1.0

First Netsidian release: a web-native, Obsidian-style Markdown workspace in a
single Go binary with SQLite — plain `.md` files in a normal folder tree, with
identity, revisions, search, links, graph, boards and agent access managed
around them. Available in the browser and as a native desktop app.

## What ships

- **Vaults (spaces):** real folders of Markdown files plus attachments; export any vault as a portable ZIP.
- **Three editors, one file:** CodeMirror source editor, lossless-gated Milkdown WYSIWYG, and a rich read view (callouts, tasks, diagrams, tables).
- **Revisions & history:** every save is an immutable revision; history feed, restore, idempotent operation journal.
- **Links & graph:** `[[wikilinks]]`, backlinks, unresolved-link previews, link-analysis API, graph v2 with memos and folder colors.
- **Kanban boards:** boards are folders, columns are subfolders, tasks are ordinary Markdown notes; drag cards, edit in a resizable preview, moves preserve links.
- **File workflows:** PDF tabs with text-to-Markdown conversion, attachment moves and trash, system-file drop and clipboard import.
- **Memos & daily notes:** folder-based quick capture, chronological timeline, reload-safe drafts.
- **Authentication:** private loopback mode, local accounts (Argon2id), OpenID Connect or both; TOTP second factor with recovery codes; self-service password change that revokes every session and key; scoped personal access tokens (`nsd_<keyid>_<secret>`).
- **MCP for agents:** Streamable HTTP `/mcp` with `netsidian_*` tools, live API adapter, optional token-free desktop localhost access, durable-memory convention in ordinary Markdown.
- **Verified backup & restore:** `netsidian backup` / `netsidian restore` produce storage-aware `netsidian-backup/v1` archives covering state, managed content, attached folders and S3 vaults, with checksums and post-restore verification.
- **SQLite writer locking:** `_txlock=immediate` keeps concurrent authenticated writes (including concurrent TOTP authentication) correct under WAL.
- **Appearance:** dark/light themes and accent presets behind a WCAG 4.5:1 contrast gate; the N mark and favicon follow the resolved accent.

## Fresh state

Netsidian 0.1.0 is a new product line with its own namespaces: state directory
(`~/.local/state/netsidian`), database (`netsidian.db`), cookies (`nsd_session`,
`nsd_oauth`), PAT prefix (`nsd_…`), MCP tool names (`netsidian_*`), vault
metadata folders (`.netsidian/`), export manifest folder (`netsidian/`) and
backup format (`netsidian-backup/v1`). Start with fresh instance state;
existing accounts, sessions, tokens and sealed secrets need recreation.
There is no automatic conversion of another product line's state. Bring
Markdown notes and supported attachments through file import, or extract a
vault ZIP and attach its document folder through the folder picker. ZIP files
are not imported directly. See `docs/migration.md` for the namespace and
secret-sealing compatibility boundary.

## Downloads and deployment

Desktop archives are available for Windows x64, Linux x64, and macOS Intel and
Apple Silicon. Linux requires GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6.0; Windows requires
Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. macOS bundles are ad-hoc signed and are not
Apple notarized.

```sh
docker run -d --name netsidian -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \
  -v netsidian-state:/netsidian-state ghcr.io/pentaqilo/netsidian:0.1.0
```

Open http://localhost:3000 — the first visit runs one-time setup that creates
the operator account. Database migrations run automatically at startup.

The release includes the matching Helm chart, `SHA256SUMS`, and
`docker-image.txt` with the immutable image digest. See the repository
documentation for deployment, authentication, backups, Kanban, and file
workflows.
